explanation: These four local generated Web Panel assets are ignored and not tracked clean source. Their reviewed categories, digests and rationales are retained as local-build review facts here, rather than as tracked-source catalogue entries. A clean tracked snapshot does not contain these files; retaining their entries makes the unchanged fail-closed scanner reject REMOVED_OR_NO_LONGER_CANDIDATE.

assets.rationale: Bundled web panel artifact download uses the configured same-origin artifact API and server token; downloading a stored artifact does not admit model inference or publication.

Bundled web panel uses Vite module-preload GET and the configured authenticated App Server WebSocket. Minified component callbacks are conservative alias candidates. The server independently admits commands and model egress; browser transport alone supplies no financial authority.

Bundled MTC audit invokes the envelope composable fetch method, which sends an authenticated MTC envelope read through the App Server WebSocket; the fetch name is a conservative candidate, not a direct provider transport.

Bundled remote session uses operator-paired relay/direct WebSocket control, scoped authentication and encrypted envelopes. Minified cryptographic math and callback aliases also match conservatively. Remote command authority and downstream costs remain independently enforced by the host.

retainedAgentCoreReview.rationale: Canonical provider/tool execution host retains scoped model egress. Host-created oversized tool results now use complete bounded JSON previews, excerpt omission and private WeakMap output identities; these do not supply model or financial authority. Existing transport admission and usage settlement remain independent.

cleanValidation.snapshotMethod: git archive --format=tar <sourceCommit> packages/cli; raw tracked Git bytes, no local generated assets copied
cleanValidation.nodeModules: External junction to existing repository root node_modules for imports; located outside both audit roots.
cleanValidation.gitContext: Read-only GIT_DIR to the original repository with GIT_WORK_TREE set to the tracked snapshot; scanner-reported sourceCommit checked against the archive commit.

limitations: Validation covers every configured audit root: packages/cli/src and packages/cli/scripts. Repository-root scripts is not an audit root in this command; unrelated repository paths were not archived.
The dependency junction reuses the existing root node_modules rather than a new npm install. This is static source review only and does not grant paid admission or verify runtime coverage.
Generated asset review facts describe only the four existing local build files and do not attest future rebuilt assets or published package content.
